content_metadata.description: A man demonstrates how he sets up his tarpaulin and other gear when camping.

qAndA.answer: He has set it up in a diamond shape.
qAndA.question: What shape has the man set his tarpaulin up in?

qAndA.answer: He keeps his sleeping bag and dry sack inside.
qAndA.question: What does the man keep in his wash basin?

qAndA.answer: He uses it to put his feet on when he gets up to put his boots on, so he doesn't stand on the grass.
qAndA.question: Why does the man have a blanket with a waterproof bottom?

qAndA.answer: He drops the posts down, so the tarpaulin is closer to the ground.
qAndA.question: What does the man do with his tarpaulin posts at night time?

qAndA.answer: He does it so that the wind doesn't blow the rain in and get his sleeping gear wet.
qAndA.question: Why does the man drop the posts of the tarpaulin down at night time?
